sources_tried: Seed file baltimore.json: worked. Maps gave MD Partitions, R.B. Fulton and Partition Plus; the rest were remodelers, plumbers and stores, skipped. Web redirects resolved via curl to Facebook, Procore, D&B and supplier pages.

Company sites: partitionplus.com, mdpartitions.com, rbfulton.com and topkeyconstruction.com worked; ultimate-installs.com returned 503; frankmwaters.com, fmwaters.com and districtinstallations.com did not resolve (guessed domains, may not exist).
Bobrick find-a-rep: page loads but results need a JS dropdown, so no reps were shown.
Scranton Products where-to-buy: worked, but it lists only a product specialist for DC/DE/MD/NJ/VA, with no local installers or dealers.
Hadrian find-a-rep: 404. Bradley find-a-rep: no content (JS). ASI, Metpar, General Partitions and Ammco locators: not reached before the search budget ran out.

The Blue Book (thebluebook.com iProView pages): blocked (403). Search snippets showed Frank M. Waters Inc. and Accessible Construction Supply Inc. Accessible Construction Supply is in Huntingtown MD (about 50 mi away, outside the radius), so it was skipped.
Procore network: the profile page for Installation Services LLC worked; search pages ignore the trade or keyword filter, so nothing came back.
BBB (prod.bbb.org Partition Plus profile): blocked (403). Yelp: no pages came up in search.
Facebook (District Installations, JJ Partitions): login wall, no data.

WebSearch: 8 of 8 used. Queries: toilet partition installation Baltimore; Division 10 in Laurel/Jessup/Annapolis/Baltimore; the seed names; Frank M. Waters; Accessible Construction Supply; Division 10 MD; Bowie/College Park/Laurel/Annapolis; Yelp/BBB. Results were dominated by One Point Partitions (a manufacturer with a Baltimore delivery terminal, skipped as a manufacturer) and national or out-of-area firms (Cook & Boardman, UDH Group, Martin Bros CA, Berl's NC, Commercial Door Worx NC), all skipped.

candidates.name: MD Partitions Inc. (MDP)
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage says it supplies, delivers and installs toilet partitions, lockers and Division 10 specialties. Named commercial projects include the Baltimore Convention Center, the U.S. Capitol and Walter Reed.
red_flags: Supplies partitions itself (in-stock partitions, 48-hour delivery), so it is a buy-around risk
candidates.reason: Commercial toilet partition supply-and-install firm in Jessup, between Baltimore and Laurel, serving MD, DC and VA. It installs partitions, but it also sells them.

license.name: MD Partitions Inc. (MDP)
license.registry: Baltimore City DHCD E-Permits (Accela Citizen Access) licensee search, https://aca-prod.accela.com/BALTIMORE/GeneralProperty/PropertyLookUp.aspx?isLicensee=Y
license.note: Maryland has no state license for commercial partition installation (MHIC covers residential home improvement only). Baltimore requires a contractor's license to be registered in E-Permits before the contractor can be added to a permit. The E-Permits licensee search is public and needs no account (DHCD help center: 'you do not need to create an account to search permit or license registration information in E-Permits'), but it is an ASP.NET search form that shows no records until submitted, so automated lookup didn't work. Check by hand by business name. Base city: Jessup. Registration status unknown.
